notes.title: Performance Improvements Update
notes.content:
Hello Community! 
We have fixed some of the performance issues, now you can enjoy Backrooms: No Return more smoothly. 
We keep working to have a quality game and have good results in the full release.

Thank you very much!

FriedGPU

notes.title: Thanks for Your Support & Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has played our game. We know the release didn’t go as smoothly as we had hoped, but your support means the world to us.

Please remember that this is not the final version, and we’re still working hard to bring you the full release. We appreciate your patience and ask for a bit of empathy as we continue to improve the game.

We’re already hard at work on an update that will fix some of the bugs you’ve encountered. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and we’re committed to making the game better for everyone.

Thank you for sticking with us—we’ve got exciting improvements coming soon!

FriedGPU Team
